to.statement: Broadcom's guided AI acceleration depends on a small number of AI infrastructure customers — Anthropic and OpenAI are named by secondary reporting as major demand drivers, with a reported plan to double AI semiconductor revenue in each of the next two years, and Google is now a confirmed named customer that has committed to expanding custom ASIC / TPU orders with Broadcom for next-generation accelerator deployment (Reuters, 2026-09-10) — whose capex, renegotiation, and in-house or alternative-supplier silicon decisions sit outside Broadcom's control (a hyperscaler awarding custom AI chip work to competitor Marvell moved AVGO shares 3.9%). Google's confirmed expansion is direct counter-evidence to near-term competitive displacement at that customer, but the revenue share attributable to individual AI customers remains unquantified, so the concentration exposure is still central to the thesis and unmeasured.
